cn.t: Critics largely embrace this revival of the acclaimed 1998 production, praising Alan Cumming's brilliant return as the Emcee and the show's dark, immersive staging, though some question restaging it so soon.

vs.sum: The legendary former nightclub retains a distinctive atmosphere even in its theatrical configuration. However, comfort is among the worst on Broadway — the rear mezzanine is extremely steep with limited guardrails and tight legroom throughout both levels.

acc.note: No elevator to Mezzanine. 10 induction loops. 81 assistive listening devices. Orchestra wheelchair seating.
